text: Marcus - dad passed Tues night. funeral prob 14 Nov, tbc. send card + flowers to his mum's
Vera back from Lisbon Sun. loved it, wants to go back in the spring w/ her sister

Kavya - made redundant @ Barclays, last day 31/10. bit shell shocked, 9 yrs there. says the payout is ok-ish but she's worried abt the mortgage. thinking of retraining, maybe teaching, sometime in the new year. her sister says she's barely leaving the house. remind me to check in end of next wk + take her for lunch
Yetunde & Rhys - honeymoon in Bali, fly out 3rd of Dec @ 6am. 14hr flight, she hates flying
Niamh + Liam split up. been coming for a while apparently. she's staying at her mum's for now
call Lachlan re his nan's funeral - Fri at 11, St Mary's. ask if he wants a lift

Ximena - Mexico City trip off, airline cancelled the flights 2 days before, still waiting on the refund. gutted bc her abuela is 90 this yr and she wanted to see her. going to Porto instead sometime after Christmas w/ her flatmate. might do Mexico in the summer instead. ask her if the refund came through
Antoine: grandad's funeral was yesterday. said it went ok, lots of family over from Lyon. check in w/ him next week
Farah lost her job - whole team cut. interviewing @ Monzo soon-ish. nervous. text her good luck b4
Ifeoma's dog Biscuit put down Sat. she's gutted. don't forget to message her tmrw morning

Farid flying to Lagos 22/11, overnight, lands 6am. back mid Jan. long haul w/ 2 kids under 5 lol. his wife going a wk later after her work do. first time the kids meet his grandma. he's worried abt the youngest's ears on the flight. ask how the flight went
Shreya - vegan now, also gluten free. dinner @ hers sometime in Nov
Seo-yeon's mum visiting from Seoul in the spring - first time in UK. S nervous abt hosting
Vanessa & Xavier - anniversary trip to Rome, 8th-12th Oct. ask how it was!
Lucy - Uncle Pete died last month, funeral was delayed. now the 19th at half 2. Emily driving her up. I should send flowers to the house b4 then
Emily = Em. new job @ Deloitte from Mon. moving to Leeds sometime in the new year
Valentina's brother Ignacio getting married in Buenos Aires, March-ish. she's flying out 2 wks early. gift idea: she wants a decent carry-on case
Ignacio - redundancy meeting Thurs at 3pm. struggling, not sleeping. ring him Thurs eve
Fang - Japan in April w/ her partner. cherry blossom. 3 wks. jealous

Shanice & Arturo broke up. wedding's off - was meant to be 14 June. Shanice moving out end of month, back to her parents' in Croydon for now. she's putting a brave face on. venue deposit lost. need to check on her this wknd
Arturo said Shanice took the cat (Pepper). he's v quiet about it all

Petra Popescu - mum's 70th in Bucharest 5th of Jan, Sat at 7pm. flying out the 2nd, back the 8th. she's organising the whole thing from here - venue, cake, 60 guests, her brother being useless. v stressed, not sleeping. said a bottle of decent Romanian wine wd go down well w/ her mum. should ring her the wk before to see how it's going

Samir - lost his dad in the summer, first Christmas w/o him coming up. his mum wants everyone at hers but Samir's not sure he can face it. thinking of going away instead, somewhere hot, maybe Tenerife. his wife Hana keen. remember to check in early Dec, and maybe invite them round over the hols
Joanna - knee op 12/12, then recovery ~6 wks. so no ski trip this yr
Rhys - into fly fishing now?? going to Scotland for it in the spring
Kieran's partner Adriana pregnant!! due June. they're telling ppl after the 12wk scan, 4 Nov
Liam - sister Joanna made redundant too. tough yr for that family
Jonah grandma's funeral Weds 10am. can't go - must send card + donate to the hospice instead
Marcus: back at work from Mon. says he's fine. prob not. coffee w/ him sometime next wk
dentist 14/11 @ 9.15
book airport parking - Gatwick, 2nd-16th Feb
passport renewal!! expires 3 May. do before the Feb trip
Vera - starting new job @ British Airways cabin crew, training from 3rd of Jan. ask how wk 1 goes
Kavya says her husband Dev also at risk @ his work. both worried. their kids at nursery so money tight
Yetunde back from Bali - jet lag awful, 'never again 14hrs'. Rhys got food poisoning day 3 lol. ask her for the photos
Niamh - dropping hints about the Lush gift set. bday 27th Nov
Lachlan - Aussie, from Perth. hasn't been home in 4 yrs. going back for 6 wks after Christmas!
Ximena Santos: works in A&E @ St Thomas', nights mostly. loves bouldering
Antoine's mum not well since the funeral - hospital appt Fri morning. he's taking her
Farah got the Monzo job!!! starts 1st Dec. send congrats
Ifeoma - thinking of getting a new puppy, maybe in the spring. not ready yet
Farid - Dr Ibrahim to the kids lol. GP @ the Southside practice. huge Arsenal fan
Shreya's grandad passed in Pune, she flies out tonight at 11. back maybe 2 wks. remind me to text her when she lands
Seo-yeon - Fang's cousin. met @ Fang's bday. into k-dramas + pottery
Xavier Le: leaving drinks Fri at 6, The Crown. he's going to Singapore w/ work for 2 yrs, moving early Jan. get him a card - pass round office
Vanessa - new flat viewing Sat at 10. if it works out she moves sometime in Dec

Lucy - called after the funeral. said it was a nice send off, Uncle Pete would've loved it. her aunt not coping tho. Lucy's going back up next month to help sort the house. I should send something to the aunt - maybe a hamper. also ask Emily if she wants to go halves
Valentina's flight to BA - 15/03 @ 7.40am, via Madrid. 16 hrs total. Ignacio's wedding the 22nd. she's doing a reading at it, terrified. text her good luck the morning of
Kieran - trying to get to Adriana's family in Brazil b4 the baby. maybe Feb?
Arturo: new job in Madrid from Jan, fresh start after the breakup. moving out there just after New Year. ask how the move went
Petra back from Bucharest. party was lovely, mum cried. Petra exhausted. her brother didn't show - drama
Samir & his wife Hana - 10th anniversary 6/12. going to Marrakech for it, 4 nights
Joanna: op moved!! now 9th Jan at 8am. hospital rang this morning
Rhys - mum's retirement do 29/11, 7pm. he's doing a speech, v nervous. don't forget to wish him luck Fri
gym 6am tmrw then food shop

Jonah's parents divorcing after 30 yrs. he only found out Sun when his dad rang. his mum's moving to her sister's in Cork sometime soon. Jonah's not ok, signed off work for a wk. said he might fly over to see her end of Nov. need to call him Weds eve, around 8
Kieran nickname = Kez. lives in Hackney w/ Adriana and their greyhound Bolt

long chat w/ Marcus last night. his mum selling the family house sometime in the spring - too many memories. he's helping her sort it. Marcus thinking of a trip to Japan after, solo, to clear his head. said he's doing a bit better. remind me to send him that Kyoto list
Liam - got his 2nd interview @ Rolls-Royce, Thurs at 2pm. nervous. Joanna says he's prepped loads. text Weds night
Christmas plans - at mum's 24th-27th, then Edinburgh for NY. book train soon
